profile.summary: ameyms is a **Senior JavaScript developer** specializing in **optimizing and maintaining legacy jQuery codebases**. With deep expertise in **performance tuning, ES5 compatibility, and unit testing**, they have contributed critical improvements to jQuery’s core array methods (grep, filter, merge) and deprecated API cleanup. Their work focuses on **micro-optimizations** (byte-level savings, native method adoption) and **test-driven development**, ensuring robustness in older browser environments. While their contributions are **ES5-focused**, their **legacy code maintenance** and **build tooling awareness** (e.g., Grunt.js) highlight their ability to work with mature, large-scale JavaScript projects.

Performance Engineering: Native Array Method Adoption (filter vs. grep)
Testing & Quality Assurance: Edge Case Testing (Sparse Arrays, Empty Inputs)
JavaScript Fundamentals: Manual Loop vs. Native Method Trade-offs
